subject: RENAMES clause
notes: kb/Work PB1283 (wave 1011 B2). cite.py --check 13.18.45.3 'The beginning of the storage area described by data-name-3 shall not precede the beginning of the storage area described by data-name-2' OK SR11. The old test (data-name-3 ends before data-name-2 BEGINS, citing GR2) was a strict subset; both halves are asked now, in bits for a record holding a bit item, else bytes: start3 >= start2 and end3 > end2. A SHORTER redefinition of an earlier item as data-name-3 (`A THRU B`, B redefining A's first two characters) is therefore refused - the PB96 golden's AB alias is removed and the CONFORMANCE.md determination corrected: ISO's syntax rule controls over the offset arithmetic GnuCOBOL and IBM accept.
